items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: AppShell composite block. Layer: Composite Block (`src/components/blocks/`) Foundation: Built strictly from primitives and design tokens: - `Sidebar` compound primitives (`Sidebar.Provider`, `Sidebar.Header`, `Sidebar.Content`, `Sidebar.Footer`, `Sidebar.Trigger`, `Sidebar.Rail`, `Sidebar.Inset`, `Sidebar.Menu`, `Sidebar.MenuItem`, `Sidebar.MenuButton`, `Sidebar.MenuBadge`) (`src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx`) - `NavigationBar`, `NavigationBar.Item` (`src/components/ui/navigation-bar.tsx`) - `Icon` (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx`)

taxonomy: Coordinated application layout shell managing navigation across breakpoints and height classes.
Morphing Navigation Pipeline:
Mobile (<640px): Thumb-accessible Bottom Navigation Bar + compact top bar.
Tablet / Foldable (640px–1023px): Automatic icon-rail sidebar (56px) preserving reading width; bottom bar hidden.
Desktop (1024px+): Full persistent sidebar (256px) with expandable groups and actions.
Compact Height (`short:` / `<480px`): Top bar compresses to 56px (h-14); bottom bar hides to preserve vertical canvas.
Zero direct `<button>` tags outside primitives.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: Chat composite block. Layer: Composite Block (`src/components/blocks/`) Foundation: Built strictly from primitives: - `MessageScroller` (`src/components/ui/message-scroller.tsx`) - `ChatMessage` (`src/components/ui/chat-message.tsx`) - `PromptInput` (`src/components/ui/prompt-input.tsx`) - `SuggestionChips` (`src/components/ui/suggestion-chips.tsx`) - `EmptyState` (`src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx`) Specification & Reference: - https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/ai-elements/base/chat - https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/ai-elements/base/prompt-input

taxonomy: Controlled presentational chat workspace assembling the streaming viewport engine, assistant/user messages, suggestion prompts, and message composer.
Supports both Docked (pinned bottom) and Floating Island (centered, floating) prompt positioning.
Supports Model Selection, Reasoning Effort, and Tool Toggles.
Pure UI: receives items via props, emits intents via callbacks. Zero direct fetch or auth.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant: 44px minimum touch targets on all interactive elements.
Strictly follows DESIGN.md tokens: floating 2px focus ring, semantic high-contrast colors, concentric radius, zero triple-tints.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: DataTable composite block. Layer: Composite Block (`src/components/blocks/`) Foundation: Built strictly from Base UI primitives, TanStack Table, and design tokens: - `Table`, `TableHeader`, `TableBody`, `TableRow`, `TableHead`, `TableCell` (`src/components/ui/table.tsx`) - `Button` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx`) - `Input` (`src/components/ui/input.tsx`) - `Select` (`src/components/ui/select.tsx`) - `Menu` (`src/components/ui/menu.tsx`) - `Checkbox` (`src/components/ui/checkbox.tsx`) - `Badge` (`src/components/ui/badge.tsx`) - `Icon` (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx`) - `@tanstack/react-table`

taxonomy: Enterprise-grade, accessible data table composite block conforming to shadcn/ui Data Table specification.

Powers complex data exploration with column sorting, global & column text filtering, faceted category filtering, row selection, dynamic column visibility toggling, loading/empty states, and accessible pagination.

Conforms to DESIGN.md Table rules: 56px minimum row height, right-aligned numeric columns with tabular-nums and font-mono, concentric geometry, floating focus rings, and container-query responsiveness (@container).

Exports both all-in-one <DataTable /> and composable subcomponents: DataTableColumnHeader, DataTablePagination, DataTableViewOptions, DataTableFacetedFilter, DataTableToolbar, DataTableRowActions, createSelectColumn, createActionsColumn.

items.name: list-detail-block
items.title: List Detail Block
items.description: ListDetailBlock composite block. Layer: Composite Block (`src/components/blocks/`) Foundation: Built strictly from primitives and design tokens: - `Button` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx`) - `Field` (`Field.Root`, `Field.Label`) (`src/components/ui/field.tsx`) - `InputGroup` (`InputGroup.Addon`, `InputGroup.Input`, `InputGroup.Button`) (`src/components/ui/input-group.tsx`) - `Item` (`Item.Group`, `Item.Media`, `Item.Content`, `Item.Title`, `Item.Description`, `Item.Actions`) (`src/components/ui/item.tsx`) - `Badge` (`src/components/ui/badge.tsx`) - `Icon` (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx`) - `Empty` (`src/components/ui/empty.tsx`)

taxonomy: Canonical master-detail multi-pane block for data-dense workflows (caseload, exercises, session notes).
Implements responsive container queries (`@container`):
On large containers (`@2xl:` / `>=672px`): Side-by-side two-pane split with selectable list and detail view.
On compact containers (`<672px`): Stack navigation. Renders list full-width; pushes detail view with an accessible back button when an item is selected.
Active selection: 2px flush primary border + primary-container wash (`Item variant="selected"`).
Touch targets: All list items maintain >=56px height (`Item size="lg"`, WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8).
Accessible keyboard navigation: Listbox roving focus via ArrowDown / ArrowUp / Home / End, selection via Enter / Space / click, and Escape to return on compact views.
Zero direct `<button>` or `<input>` tags outside primitives.

items.name: metric-card
items.title: Metric Card
items.description: MetricCard block. @deprecated Prefer composing `Card` (with a divided `<dl>` stat strip), `Item.Group`, `RadialChartCard`, or `Table` (`numeric: true`) directly to avoid metric card grids. items.name: pie-chart-card

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Questionnaire composite block. Layer: Composite Block (`src/components/blocks/`) Foundation: Built strictly from Base UI primitives and design tokens: - `Button` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx`) - `Input` (`src/components/ui/input.tsx`) - `Progress` (`src/components/ui/progress.tsx`) - `Icon` (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx`) - `Kbd` (`src/components/ui/kbd.tsx`)

taxonomy: Multi-step guided question primitive and flow engine for intake forms, assessments, onboarding sequences, configuration wizards, and conversational agent clarification prompts.

Follows the shadcn/ui Questionnaire part structure and API: Root, Progress, Item, Title, Description, Choices, Choice, ChoiceInput, ChoiceLabel, ChoiceShortcut, Input, Error, Actions, Previous, Skip, Next, and Submit. Items take `multiple` (the legacy `type="multiple"` still works) and answers serialize to FormData with one repeated entry per selected value (`FormData.getAll(name)`). Choices are role-based rather than native radio/checkbox inputs.

Supports single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform text entry, keyboard shortcuts (A-Z, 1-9), roving tabindex arrow key navigation, form validation, draft restoration, and native FormData serialization.

Accessible: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant (min-h-11 touch targets), floating 2px focus indicators, fieldset/legend semantics, inert inactive items, live error regions, and container-query responsiveness (@container).

items.name: radar-chart-card
items.title: Radar Chart Card
items.description: RadarChartCard block. Controlled presentational radar / spider card for multi-factor profile assessments, clinical competency pillars, and benchmark polygon overlays. Composes ChartCard and Chart primitives with polar grids, high-contrast polygons, and accessible tooltips.

items.name: radial-chart-card
items.title: Radial Chart Card
items.description: RadialChartCard block. Controlled presentational semicircle gauge card for capacity monitoring, threshold alerts, and target achievement. The arc color comes from the `value` entry in `config`; without one it falls back to the primary color. Composes ChartCard, Badge, and Chart primitives with a 180° radial arc and high-contrast status tokens.

items.name: step-wizard
items.title: Step Wizard
items.description: StepWizard composite block. Layer: Composite Block (`src/components/blocks/`) Foundation: Built strictly from Base UI primitives and design tokens: - `Card` (`Card.Header`, `Card.Title`, `Card.Description`, `Card.Content`, `Card.Footer`) (`src/components/ui/card.tsx`) - `Button`, `UnstyledButton` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx`) - `Separator` (`src/components/ui/separator.tsx`) - `Progress` (`src/components/ui/progress.tsx`) - `Icon` (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx`)

taxonomy: Controlled multi-step workflow container for guided intake, onboarding, assessment flows, and multi-stage form sequences.
Pure UI: receives step data via props, manages directional slide transitions, and emits progression intents via callbacks (`onStepChange`, `onComplete`).

Accessible: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant (44x44px minimum touch targets on all interactive step markers and buttons), floating 2px focus indicators (`outline-offset: 2px`), and live regions (`aria-live="polite"`).
Modern HTML integration: supports `hiddenUntilFound` with `hidden="until-found"` and `beforematch` event listener so browser search (<kbd>Ctrl+F</kbd>) finds inactive step content.

items.name: supporting-pane-block
items.title: Supporting Pane Block
items.description: SupportingPaneBlock composite block. Layer: Composite Block (`src/components/blocks/`) Foundation: Built strictly from primitives and design tokens: - `Button` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx`) - `Icon` (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx`) - `Badge` (`src/components/ui/badge.tsx`)

taxonomy: Canonical supporting pane layout for focused tasks (audio drill canvas, exercise workspace) paired with an auxiliary side inspector (clinician tips, phonetic targets, session notes).
Implements responsive container queries (`@container`):
On large containers (`@3xl:` / `>=768px`): Side-by-side layout with docked pane (left or right).
On compact containers (`<768px`): Full-width stacked layout below the primary workspace.
On compact height (`short:`): Tightens top bar height while preserving 44px touch target focus rings.
Targeted opacity transition (`duration-quick`, zero `transition-all`) with reduced-motion fallback.
Restores keyboard focus cleanly when closed from inside the pane and marks closed panes inert.
Zero direct `<button>` tags outside primitives.
